rules.content:
title: Card Testing Micro-Authorization Velocity Spike
status: experimental
description: Detects high velocity of sub-dollar ($0.01-$0.99) authorization attempts from the same merchant or source against multiple distinct card numbers, a pattern characteristic of automated card testing ope
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: payment_gateway
detection:
    selection:
        transaction_amount|lt: 1.0
        event_type|contains:
            - "authorization"
            - "auth_request"
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 50
        groupby: "merchant_id"
        timeframe: "1h"
    filter_card_diversity:
        dc_card_number_hash|gte: 30
    filter_decline_rate:
        decline_rate|gte: 0.5
    condition: selection and aggregation and filter_card_diversity and filter_decline_rate
level: high
rules.title: DL-0083: Card Testing Micro-Authorization Velocity Spike (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: BIN Enumeration Sequential Card Number Attack
status: experimental
description: Detects sequential or near-sequential card number authorization attempts sharing the same Bank Identification Number (BIN) prefix with incremental variation in the remaining digits. BIN enumeration at
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: payment_gateway
detection:
    selection:
        transaction_amount|lt: 5.0
        event_type|contains:
            - "authorization"
            - "auth_request"
    aggregation_bin:
        count|gte: 10
        groupby:
            - "merchant_id"
            - "bin_prefix_8"
        timeframe: "30m"
    filter_sequential:
        sequential_card_numbers|gte: 5
        card_number_increment_pattern: true
    filter_decline:
        decline_rate|gte: 0.8
    condition: selection and aggregation_bin and filter_sequential and filter_decline
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0084: BIN Enumeration Sequential Card Number Attack (Sigma)
